spec.purpose: Load fixed BF16 tensors once in runtime order with disjoint ordinary shard owners and original source bytes. Build only; original product boundaries remain required.

Original q8192/out512 with single-copy ordered fixed and packed text storage, original BF16 tensor bytes, compact-Q CK and cross-chunk scratch reuse. Require all 512 original GB10 IDs, first-logit tolerance 0.125, actual callbacks, source identities, 26 actual shard layouts, shared fixed aliases and unchanged host cleanup. Original guards and fixed-weight consumers remain enabled without a duplicate owner. Physical-memory benefit, retained performance and release qualification remain separate measurements.
